method: Local read-only IDA 9.1 analysis; important control flow checked against assembly. No system configuration mutation or driver execution.

ssde_service_query.meaning: No service with the exact name ssde is installed; other service names were not enumerated.

local_observations.observation: Existing protected enrollment DWORD takes precedence over caller initialization candidate. Distinct first-initialization handling exists.
Only direct code caller found for the enrollment reader/initializer; consumes boot-context candidate. Product license query is separate.
Calls licensing/enrollment initialization before initializing policy from loader data.
Enrollment gate checked before base-policy and signature conditions.
Enrollment and Secure Boot mode gates remain independent of policy signature properties.
CKS reevaluation requires the existing boot-established CKS developer-mode bit. No call to enrollment initializer in observed refresh chain.
Reads protected enrollment before policy evaluation. Existing disabled enrollment does not opt into CKS. Assembly checked.
Serializes policy allowance into CI loader state; system-upgrade indicator is independent, with no observed override of existing disabled enrollment.
Loader requires enrollment gate, Secure Boot mode, base policy and verified signature properties.
Uses firmware PK and actual UEFI signed-policy verifier. Assembly returns verifier status; pseudocode alone was misleading.
Uses firmware KEK and UEFI signed-policy verifier. Assembly checked: call at RVA 0x1A16C8; preserves result at 0x1A16CD and returns it at 0x1A1703. Pseudocode was misleading.
Initializes the isolated CKS enrollment gate from boot-context licensing and CKS bits. Important assembly branch checked.
Checks isolated enrollment gate before base policy and verified signature properties. Only observed direct code references to gate byte were initialization write and this read.
Policy-update branch delegates to CipRefreshPolicies; no first-enrollment operation in the checked entry.
Isolated runtime policy refresh also requires the existing boot-established CKS developer-mode bit.
Observed HVCI/CET configuration generalization, not a dedicated CKS enrollment interface.
Observed VBS/HVCI specialization entry; does not prove absence of CKS logic in all Setup components.
Observed VBS/HVCI specialization entry; not called during this research.

installation_manifest_evidence.scope: 10 name-matched CodeIntegrity manifests in WinSxS/Manifests; 258 .man/.xml/.manifest files in System32/migwiz/dlmanifests and replacementmanifests; no Panther/Rollback log reads.

decoder.result: All 10 manifests decoded and XML parsed in memory; wcp.dll code was not loaded.

codeintegrity_9022.observation: CI\Protected appears in ordinary registry defaults, but not in this component's migration include/exclude. No explicit CustomKernelSignerLockedEnabled entry. This does not determine Setup core's whole-hive migration behavior.

codeintegrity_1746.observation: Same migration include/exclude patterns as the checked 9022 component manifest.

tcblaunch_replacement.observation: HVCI EnabledBootId in exclude block; unrelated to dedicated CKS enrollment.
